mfa.descOff: Increase security by requiring a code from your phone in addition to your password when signing in.
mfa.descOn: Your account is protected with two-step authentication. You will need a code from your authenticator app every time you sign in.
mfa.qrFallback: If the QR code does not appear, use the manual code below.
mfa.scanHint: Scan the QR code and confirm with the 6-digit code.
mfa.disableConfirm: Are you sure you want to disable two-step authentication?
mfa.fallbackGeneric: Could not complete the MFA operation.
mfa.invalidCode: Invalid code. Check your authenticator app and try again.
mfa.expired: Code expired. Generate a new code in your authenticator app.
mfa.rateLimit: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few seconds and try again.
mfa.factorNotFound: MFA factor not found. Reload the page and try again.
mfa.factorIdentifyError: Could not identify the MFA factor to disable.
